author: The Wall Street Journal
description:
Open-plan offices were created to enable collaboration and communication. Now, the design has left many longing for the return of the cubicle. As individual focus space continues to shrink across offices, WSJ sits down with two designers to explore how floor plans could better support uninterrupted work. Watch the video to find out why you might be struggling to concentrate at your desk.
